pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.2: tena kho pana samayena devadatto parihīnalābhasakkāro sapariso kulesu viññāpetvā viññāpetvā bhuñjati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā kulesu viññāpetvā viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.5: kassa sampannaṃ na manāpaṃ kassa sāduṃ na ruccatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma devadatto sapariso kulesu viññāpetvā viññāpetvā bhuñjissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.9: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ devadatta sapariso kulesu viññāpetvā viññāpetvā bhuñjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.12: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa sapariso kulesu viññāpetvā viññāpetvā bhuñjissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.13: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:1.16: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā gilāne bhikkhū bhattena nimantenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.2: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā nādhivāsenti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā gaṇabhojananti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.4: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā gaṇabhojanaṃ bhuñjituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.6: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.8: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:2.9: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:6.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū manussehi saddhiṃ nāvāya gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:6.2: athakho te bhikkhū te manusse etadavocuṃ muhuttaṃ āvuso tīraṃ nāvaṃ upanetha piṇḍāya carissāmāti.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:6.10: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.1: tena kho pana samayena disāsu vassaṃ vutthā bhikkhū rājagahaṃ āgacchanti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.2: manussā nānāverajjake bhikkhū passitvā bhattena nimantenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.3: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā nādhivāsenti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā gaṇabhojananti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.6: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.8: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo addhānagamanasamayo nāvābhirūhanasamayo mahāsamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:7.9: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.1: tena kho pana samayena rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa ñātisālohito ājīvakesu pabbajito hoti. athakho so ājīvako yena rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ seniyaṃ bimbisāraṃ etadavoca icchāmahaṃ mahārāja sabbapāsaṇḍikaṃ bhattaṃ kātunti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.2: sace tvaṃ bhante buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṭhamaṃ bhojeyyāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.4: athakho so ājīvako bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesi adhivāsentu me bhikkhū svātanāya bhattanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.5: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā nādhivāsenti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā gaṇabhojananti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.6: athakho so ājīvako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so ājīvako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.9: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.11: athakho so ājīvako bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.12: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:8.16: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo addhānagamanasamayo nāvābhirūhanasamayo mahāsamayo samaṇabhattasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.2: yattha cattāro bhikkhū pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantitā bhuñjanti etaṃ gaṇabhojanaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.6: antamaso pādāpi phālitā honti. gilānasamayoti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.8: anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimo māso atthate kaṭhine pañca māsā. cīvaradānasamayoti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.12: aḍḍhayojanaṃ gamissāmīti bhuñjitabbaṃ. gacchantena bhuñjitabbaṃ. āgatena bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.14: nāvaṃ abhirūhissāmīti bhuñjitabbaṃ. ārūḷhena bhuñjitabbaṃ. orūḷhena bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.16: yattha dve tayo bhikkhū piṇḍāya caritvā yāpenti catutthe āgate na yāpenti. mahāsamayoti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.18: yo koci paribbājakasamāpanno bhattaṃ karoti. samaṇabhattasamayoti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.1.19: aññatra samayā bhuñjissāmīti paṭiggaṇhāti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.2.1: gaṇabhojane gaṇabhojanasaññī aññatra samayā bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.2.2: gaṇabhojane vematiko aññatra samayā bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyasla.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc32:9.2.3: gaṇabhojane nagaṇabhojanasaññī aññatra samayā bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
